chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: His mother, father and wife in 1935
summary: His father died in 1921 and his mother in 1941; he supported them and his family while married with no children.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: What was happening with your family now. Were they all up in New York now or --
He's dead, he died in '21, my mother died in '45, in '41 or '45.
Your mother was still alive when --
Well, "Porgy and Bess" was what year?
My mother was living then. She died in '41.
And she's up in New York, too.
She's dead. She was up in New York then.
Did you have any financial commitment to your family in terms of supporting your sisters or your mother at this particular time?
I did all along. As long as they were alive, as long as I was working, I helped them out, mh-hm.
You were still married at this time.
